TestName: loads and exposes Contact Us within Test Automation Challenges
Steps:
1. Navigate to https://www.webdriveruniversity.com/
2. Verify brand link, Test Automation Challenges, Contact Us tile
3. Verify Contact Us href and target=_blank
ExpectedResult: Homepage loads; Contact Us tile visible, enabled, href ends with Contact-Us/contactus.html, target=_blank

TestName: opens Contact Us in a new tab from the homepage
Steps:
1. Open homepage
2. Click Contact Us tile
3. Capture new tab
4. Verify original tab URL and new tab Contact Us page
ExpectedResult: New tab opens to Contact Us; homepage tab remains; Contact Us form loaded

TestName: form structure exposes required controls
Steps:
1. Open Contact Us
2. Assert FN/LN/Email/Comments editable
3. Assert Reset and Submit enabled
ExpectedResult: All form controls visible and interactive

TestName: valid submission shows thank-you then returns to homepage
Steps:
1. Fill valid form
2. Click Submit
3. Assert Thank You message
4. Click Back to Homepage
5. Assert homepage URL + elements
TestData: FN=Automation; LN=Tester; Email=automation.tester@example.com; Comments=Automated Playwright test submission.
ExpectedResult: Thank You for your Message!; then homepage URL and brand/challenges/Contact Us visible
